title: Career Roadmap: Property Analyst
summary: Career Domain: Architecture, Construction & Built Environment · Qualification Pathway: BBA / BMS / BBM – BBA - Real Estate / Construction Management · Target Career: Property Analyst

facts.Current degree: BBA / BMS / BBM (Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Property Analyst studies real-estate markets and projects - prices, rents, demand and costs - to help developers, investors and lenders decide what to build, buy or lend on.

items.text: Collect and analyse property prices, rents and supply data
Build financial models for projects (cash flows, IRR)
Prepare market reports and feasibility studies
Track RERA filings, regulations and infrastructure plans
Understand how property is bought, built and sold in India
Study real-estate finance, valuation and RERA
Analyse prices in one city area using public data
Learn basic GIS and Power BI
Intern with a consultancy or developer
Build a full feasibility study for a sample project
Apply for research and analyst roles

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.

items.text: MBA Real Estate (e.g. RICS School of Built Environment)
PG Diploma in Real Estate Management
